abstract: Covers the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol version 1.0 as published by the Linux Foundation A2A project, pinned to specification release v1.0.1 and its normative a2a.proto. SKILL.md holds the invariants and workflow; references cover the Agent Card and its security declarations, operations and the three protocol bindings, tasks with streaming and push notifications, and security including signed Agent Cards.
